en.title: al-Sira al-Nabawiyya ("The Life of the Prophet")
en.author: Muhammad ibn Ishaq (d. 150 AH / 767 CE), in the recension of Abd al-Malik ibn Hisham (d. 213 AH / 828 CE)
en.note: The earliest connected biography of the Prophet ﷺ to survive in full. Ibn Ishaq's own text is lost; it survives through Ibn Hisham's edited recension. The standard reference is the Cairo edition (Mustafa al-Saqa, Ibrahim al-Abyari, Abd al-Hafiz Shalabi, eds.); English readers commonly use A. Guillaume's 1955 translation, The Life of Muhammad.

en.title: al-Tabaqat al-Kubra ("The Great Book of Generations")
en.author: Muhammad ibn Sad (d. 230 AH / 845 CE)
en.note: A biographical dictionary of the Prophet ﷺ and the Companions, organized by generation (tabaqa) and, within Madinan entries, largely by tribe and clan -- the closest classical structure to the cohort model this app uses. Standard reference: the Beirut, Dar Sadir edition.

en.title: al-Isaba fi Tamyiz al-Sahaba ("Fair Judgment in Distinguishing the Companions")
en.author: Ahmad ibn Ali ibn Hajar al-Asqalani (d. 852 AH / 1449 CE)
en.note: The most comprehensive classical biographical dictionary of the Companions, roughly 12,300 entries, absorbing and cross-checking every earlier work in the genre. Sorts entries into four classes by strength of evidence for actual companionship -- a ready-made confidence signal this app's `confidence` field draws on in spirit.
